monument_title: 1491 Krakow Octoechos of Schweipolt Fiol (Осмогласник / Октоїх Швайпольта Фіоля, Краків, 1491)

fastest_overall_cohort.note: 5-leaf tail cohort (4 archival missing-leaf targets + 1866 Breslau collation certificate)

three_slowest_cohorts_subagent_execution.bottleneck_root_cause: High apparatus density (15 footnotes—3rd highest in codex) combined with 3 interleaved Sunday Matins canons in Tone 1 (Resurrection, Cross-Resurrection, Theotokos across Odes 6-9), unexpanded Katavasia/Kontakion incipit rubric with damaged glyph on leaf p24 ('всѣ ко [?]'), and the 11 Sunday Matins Praises stichera plus Beatitudes.

Dense Tone 2 Sunday Matins triple-canon interleaving (Odes 1-7) with heavy red cinnabar initial ligatures, abbreviated marginalia, and frequent switches between Resurrectional, Cross-Resurrectional, and Theotokos troparia requiring 13 critical apparatus notes.

Tone 1 -> Tone 2 structural boundary transition on leaf p34 (# TONE 2 decorative headpiece), Tone 1 Sunday Liturgy Epistle/Gospel propers, Saturday Great Vespers Dogmatikon/Aposticha, Sunday Midnight Office Triadikos Canon in Tone 2, and 16 scholarly footnotes (2nd highest in codex).

three_slowest_cohorts_end_to_end_cadence.bottleneck_root_cause: Transition from Tone 8 Sunday cycle into the consolidated Weekday Octoechos (Sunday Evening / Monday Vespers and Monday Matins Canons of Repentance and Bodiless Powers in Tone 1), highest source word count up to that point (2,516 Slavonic words), plus context-window compaction boundary right after Cohort 22.
Tone 4 Sunday Matins Odes 5-9 triple canons, Gradual Hymns (Anabathmoi), Praises, and Beatitudes with dense unspaced scriptio continua in Fiol's 25-line folio blocks.

Multi-service transition spanning Friday Matins Odes 5-9 in Tone 6, Friday Liturgy Epistle (1 Cor. 1:18-24) and Gospel (John 3:13-17), and Friday Evening (Saturday Vespers) in Tone 8 with multiple Podoben automela.

anomalies_caught_and_healed.description: 2 uncapitalized Holy Trinity Deity pronouns in Cohort 7 raw draft.

anomalies_caught_and_healed.description: Minor MTS-1 lexical/slop/-eth drift across 7 cohort files (including footnote apparatus text).
anomalies_caught_and_healed.resolution: Automatically synchronized on disk by UniversalPublicationEngine._self_heal_cohorts_and_footnotes() in scripts/compile_final_edition.py.

anomalies_caught_and_healed.description: Flash subagents enclosed Slavonic Heirmos incipits (e.g. '[Коня и всадника...]:*' in Tone 5 Cohorts 12-13) and Cyrillic quire numerals ('| 1 [а҃] |' on leaf p337 in Cohort 34) in square brackets [...] rather than parentheses (...). Gate 5A strips parenthesized Cyrillic (\([^)]*[\u0400-\u04FF][^)]*\)) before checking for residual Cyrillic in body lines.
anomalies_caught_and_healed.resolution: Healed via regex replacement converting bracketed Cyrillic \[([^\]\^]*[\u0400-\u04FF\uA640-\uA69F][^\]]*)\] -> (\1) while preserving [^N] footnote markers.

anomalies_caught_and_healed.description: Rubric '*Other Stichera to the Saint (Nicholas), in the same Tone and Model:*' triggered Gate 7A regex matching '\bModel:'.
anomalies_caught_and_healed.resolution: Normalized to canonical 3-layer Podoben reference '*Other Stichera to the Saint (Nicholas), in the same Tone, Podoben: "Called from on High" (Званный свыше):*'.

anomalies_caught_and_healed.stage: Phase 2 verify_publication_edition.py (Gate 7B: 'Podoben:' missing parenthetical Slavonic witness)
anomalies_caught_and_healed.description: (1) Cohort 8 had '*Another Canon, Ode 1, to the Most Holy Birthgiver of God. Heirmos: The same (Podoben: "Every nature bends the knee"):*' without Cyrillic witness. (2) Cohort 20 leaf p185 had '*Kontakion, Tone 8, Podoben:*[^218]' because Fiol's physical rubric printed bare 'т҃ъ гла и҃ · по[добенъ]' without naming the model melody.
anomalies_caught_and_healed.resolution: Restored parenthetical Slavonic witnesses '(Всяко естество)' in Cohort 8 and '(*подобенъ*)' in Cohort 20.

anomalies_caught_and_healed.description: OneDrive cloud reparse placeholder folder (tag 0x9000e01a) at Source Text/images caused directory junction creation to skip copying cached JPGs from Drive E vault.
anomalies_caught_and_healed.resolution: Patched scripts/extract_cohort_leaves.py to explicitly copy found_file to target_local_canon whenever target_local_canon does not exist on disk.

queued_items_audit.analysis: Leaf p14 is the Sunday Midnight Office dismissal / Royal Litany / Matins Six Psalms opening rubric where Fiol prints dense abbreviated liturgical cues and incipits ('Пса̃ · Г̃и въ силѣ твоей... Тр̃е. И по Ѻ̃че нашъ...'). Expanding mandatory liturgical abbreviations and speaker tags in English naturally yields a 2.74x character ratio without any textual fabrication.
Genuine damaged/abbreviated typeset glyph in Fiol's Ode 6 Katavasia rubric ('Бж̃твное сїе всѣ ко [?] · цꙋ иже в д̃нь'). Properly restored and documented in footnote [^21].
Genuine ink smudge/damage on leaf p193 ('да н[ынѣ [?]ти съ бл[аго]дарественовъ'). Properly bracketed and documented in apparatus.
Genuine physical missing folio in the Wrocław Stadtbibliothek copy, replaced by the archival microfilming target ('ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ'). Documented in footnote [^238].

5-column quire register / collation table ('То е́сть личба до то́й книгы...') spanning 84 gatherings across 20 rows. While structurally well-formed by Flash, Argon inspection revealed that the Cyrillic numerals were bracketed '[а҃]' rather than parenthesized '(а҃)', which helped resolve Gate 5A.

recommended_threshold_calibrations.sgc02_upper_ratio_liturgical_ordo_leaves: Raise upper SGC-02 queue threshold from 2.20 to 2.85 on leaves containing >= 4 abbreviated rubrical cues ('Тр̃е', 'Ѻ̃че нашъ', 'Г̃и помилуй', 'єктеніа') where Slavonic titla abbreviations expand 2.5x-2.8x in English.
recommended_threshold_calibrations.epigraphic_uncertainty_markers: Retain 100% sensitivity for '[?]', '[lacuna]', '[illegible]', '[damaged]', '[corrupt]' (100% true-positive rate in this run).

dimension_4_compiler_and_monument_edge_c.description: Part 8 ('part8_tone-8.md', 244,534 chars) absorbed both the Sunday Tone 8 cycle (pp. 189-214) AND the entire Weekday Octoechos cycle (Monday Tone 1 through Saturday Tone 8, pp. 214-303) because Fiol prints the weekday propers continuously after Sunday Tone 8 using inline cinnabar rubrics without a major woodcut headpiece. Conversely, the scaffold's 'part10' ('# GENERAL PARASTAS') was dropped because Fiol's rear appendix (pp. 327-336) contains the three Ascetic Homilies (Ephrem the Syrian, Sirach on Childrearing, John Chrysostom) rather than a standalone Parastas office.

In 1491_krakow_fiol_octoechos_propers_corpus.json (2,898 items), 100% of items have office='Front Matter', 2,497/2,898 have hymn_type='Sticheron', and 1,238/2,898 are assigned tone=8. This happens because Statutory Mandate 8 forbids '### At Vespers' / '### At Matins' headings in raw drafts (requiring inline italic rubrics), while extract_propers_corpus() only updates current_office on markdown headings and only updates current_tone on '# TONE N' H1 landmarks.

_collect_cohort_files() reads from Cohorts/ first and ignores Draft/ and Final MD/ once Cohorts/ is populated on the first compile pass. Subsequent deterministic fixes applied only to Draft/ or Final MD/ are silently overwritten unless applied directly to Cohorts/.

Incunabular and manuscript codices occasionally print a bare rubric 'по[добенъ]' without naming the melodic model incipit (e.g. leaf p185 '*Kontakion, Tone 8, Podoben:*[^218]'). Gate 7B requires every line containing 'Podoben:' to include a parenthetical Cyrillic string.
